summary: Separate English and Arabic first-party discovery identified the Egyptian Survey Authority as the national survey/map custodian and official Matrouh GIS/planning references. ESA's current public digital-map page is a purchase workflow with no anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry service. No parcel sample is retained.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: All executed searches and bounded routes, statuses, source-page findings, and the one TLS-verification failure are recorded in city-106-marsa-matruh.json.

custodians.name: Egyptian Survey Authority (هيئة المساحة المصرية)
custodians.scope: national surveying, cadastral/property-map records, and digital map products
custodians.evidence: official ESA homepage and digital-map service page

custodians.name: General Organization for Physical Planning / Matrouh governorate GIS-planning committee
custodians.scope: official Matrouh infrastructure/planning map coordination; not a qualified parcel registry service

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier if publicly returned and source-proven
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [31.3460995840892, 27.2526447044638] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and not shifted.
No exact-point hit or miss, map-extent miss, timeout, TLS failure, or unavailable workflow was treated as evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
ESA national custodianship and Matrouh planning/GIS references do not prove citywide public parcel-vector coverage.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, certificate, title, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is not source integration/admission.
uncertainty: No anonymous parcel schema, CRS, native identity, or unchanged polygon response was observed.
Independent serial review is required before runtime qualification.
doNotInfer: ESA purchase workflow is not a public parcel API
A TLS/login/unusable-service condition is not evidence of parcel absence
Official planning/GIS prose is not parcel-level source integration
